pkgmetadata.longdescription: SML# is a Standard ML compiler with seamless C interop, SQL integration, and MassiveThreads-based multicore support. This ebuild follows AUR smlsharp 4.2.0: the official release tarball, system MassiveThreads and GMP, and LLVM 17-20 (upstream's configure allows 7.1-20.1; llvm-r2 starts at 17).
